vdi.description: The VDI Health Monitor watches a fleet of Windows virtual desktops: mapped network drives, desktop icons, user sessions, VM identity and UDS pools, reported by two agents on every VM.
vdi.goal: One live page that tells an administrator which desktops are broken, stale or idle before a user calls.

features.icons: Desktop icon counts against a per-pool threshold
features.sessions: Active, idle and signed-out sessions with the user's name
features.identity: IP, MAC, last boot, OS version and uptime per VM
features.pools: UDS pool, cache level, publication and thin-client data
features.agents: Stale detection per agent and the full event history of every VM

roles_documented.label: Roles documented

multi_provider.label: Verified images for two providers
multi_provider.requirement: Make Hosts.template.yml render for at least two listed providers, each naming an image the box catalog serves.

release_cadence.label: Release cadence
release_cadence.requirement: Publish at least two releases in a rolling year, at least 30 days apart.

booted_providers.label: Booted on every verified provider
booted_providers.requirement: Add a CI job per verified provider that boots a machine from the rendered Hosts.yml and reports a green Boot check run on the release commit.
